note: Expected results of the general receiver (specs/general.md) on the four recordings in this folder. Every recording is 250 000 samples/s cf32_le, centre 50 kHz above the tuned frequency, so the receiver is configured with the signal at -50 000 Hz. Settings are the mode defaults unless listed: squelch on, Auto; AGC on; de-emphasis off; CW pitch 700 Hz; filter = the demodulator's default width. Feed in blocks of 25 000 samples (0.1 s); one report per 0.1 s of input. 'audio' values are measured on the 48 kHz mono audio after the squelch, before the volume: a single-bin DFT over the last 0.5 s, peak amplitude, full scale 1.0. Levels are dBFS (a complex sample of magnitude 1 is 0 dBFS power). 'squelch_timeline' has one character per report: '.' closed (state 1), 'O' open (state 2).
